review_comments.body: This unit spec unnecessarily initializes a provider/protocol and introduces a model ID unrelated to the behavior under test. `AGENTS.md:125-127` requires protocol modules to be tested through a bare extended object and limits literal model IDs to model-specific behavior. Reuse `test_obj` here to keep the regression isolated.

Full details: Linked Issues check **Explanation** `#1012` requires Gemini parallel function-call turns to replay the signature only on the call that originally carried it. The change in `format_tool_call` disables the message-level fallback when any tool call has `thought_signature`, and the new unit test verifies the duplicate-signature case. However, `#1012` also requires the original Gemini model parts to replay unchanged. This pull request still rebuilds tool-call parts from parsed content and tool calls. The diff provides no preservation of original part order or shape, and no test verifies exact round-trip replay with mixed parts. **Resolution** Preserve the original Gemini parts for assistant turns that contain `functionCall` data, or implement an equivalent exact round-trip path. Add an automated test for part order, part shape, and per-call signatures, including mixed text or thought parts.
